text: As a business selling made to order products, timelines are a lot more important to us and are critical to communicate to at the time of purchase. Wow ETA clear and simple design natively fits on our product page and has dramatically reduced enquiries, increased satisfaction leaving us time to concentrate on selling products. It has improved customer experience in measurable terms. Having tried several apps before we found WOW ETA to be the simplest and most flexible to use with easy to understand set up and rules.
Great app for showing delivery estimates. Easy to set up, works smoothly, and helps customers know when their orders will arrive. Highly recommended!

WowETA is a really great app and works exactly as expected. The setup is flexible and very useful for delivery estimations. Special thanks to Nayeem, who helped me with everything – the support was fast, clear, and extremely efficient. All requests were handled quickly and professionally. Highly recommended if you are looking for a reliable ETA solution with excellent customer support.

Thrilled to see this WordPress expert team (WPXPO) finally on Shopify! I’ve used this team’s WordPress plugins for years, so I was genuinely happy to see them finally build something for Shopify—and WowETA is excellent. Setup was quick, and the controls are practical: custom delivery rules, cut-off times, workdays, region-based estimates, and clean templates that are easy to tweak. The countdown and translations help set clear expectations for customers, which has improved our product pages. Customer support has been great—fast, friendly, and on point. If you want accurate delivery dates without fiddling with code, this app does the job really well.

WowETA is great - Glad the free tier will do the job for us until we are ready to pay for more rules. Big thanks to support who helped us get set up - We ill be a paying customer for some time I think!

Nice and very simple to use app, we can easily tailor the messages and the ETA required. We can use the default language or translate, customize the look of the Block and integrate it easily, then customize 100% the message with shortcodes. It's an "extended" feature that many themes offer as a default option, but here we have far more options. The pricing is honest if you have such needs. I would potentially lower a bit for the highest plan, as it's a side and not "vital" feature for shops. I think the break even is 3.99.
